objective: Repair the specific AK proof-tightness gap without changing the solver policy: replace AK's coarse co-incidence child upper bound by a parent-computable pairwise-compatible raw-child signed-incidence envelope, then independently replay exact DP. Either close the frozen 15-root reachable domain or preserve the first explicit certificate gap/counterexample.
frozen_domain: Exactly the inherited AH/AI/AJ/AK 15-root domain and truth-blind generation. No family, seed, selector order, budget, or success threshold may be added or changed after outcomes.
selector: Variables only, sorted by AJ local RAW_S_UB then variable id. For each candidate, evaluate the preregistered tighter certificate. No SAT truth, no model labels, no downstream exact child, and no subset search may influence pivot selection.

tighter_child_bound.name: PAIRWISE_COMPATIBLE_RAW_CHILD_INCIDENCE_ENVELOPE
tighter_child_bound.construction: For candidate pivot x, partition the canonical parent into H (pivot-free), P (contains x), and N (contains -x). Enumerate each P x N pair only to construct the parent-determined resolvent candidate R=(C+\{x}) union (C-\{-x}); discard tautological R; canonicalize and deduplicate identical R; union with H and deduplicate. This parent-computable raw set F_tilde_x is formed before subsumption minimization and before any cheap downstream policy.
tighter_child_bound.soundness_relation: The exact normalized DP child is obtained from F_tilde_x only by canonical duplicate removal/subsumption deletion, so S_child <= S_tilde. The AI signed-incidence pair mass P_hat is monotone non-increasing under clause deletion, hence P_hat_child <= P_hat_tilde. The certificate therefore upper-bounds AI child LHS by (V-1)*S_tilde + P_hat_tilde, conservatively dropping the negative -L_child-Q2_child terms.
tighter_child_bound.certificate: Let Vc=V-1 and Tc=min(B/2,floor_sqrt(B*(Vc-1))). Candidate x is symbolically self-preserving iff Vc*S_tilde(x)+P_hat_tilde(x) <= Vc*Tc, subject to the independently checked one-variable-drop assumption.
tighter_child_bound.independent_verifier: Only after symbolic selection materialize the existing exact-DP implementation. Require exact replay PASS, exactly one eliminated variable for the stated certificate, component soundness S_exact<=S_tilde and P_hat_exact<=P_hat_tilde, actual raw-child AI class membership, and terminal-or-AI-class membership after the inherited cheap policy.
tighter_child_bound.polynomial_ledger: Record |P|*|N| pair attempts, tautology skips, unique resolvents, raw-set clause/literal size, pair literal work, and certificate incidence scan work. The construction is finite polynomial work in the current representation; this ledger is not a proof of global polynomial SAT runtime.

frozen_positive_control.rule: The witness is a positive control for improved proof tightness only; its known outcome must not alter the bound after preregistration.

pass_condition: All 15 frozen roots complete without semantic mismatch; every reachable nonterminal residual has a symbolically certified pivot under the frozen tighter bound; all independent soundness and exact-DP replay checks pass.
result_policy: Do not widen, weaken, or add correction terms after seeing outcomes. If the tighter certificate fails while an actual self-preserving door exists, seal that proof gap and route it to forensics. If no actual door exists, preserve it as a solver/policy obstruction candidate. A finite pass is not a universal theorem.
